text: In 2019-11 our record shows what we repeated. Twenty-five of us said "leverage development build" by 2019-11-06; twenty-four said "to leverage development build" that same day. Fifteen said "better utilizing investments to leverage development," and fifteen said "utilizing investments to leverage development build." Susan M. Collins first said these on 2018-04-27; we were still saying them. Thirteen of us said "to leverage development build grant," first said by Christopher A. Coons on 2018-06-07. Thirteen said "on veterans day" on 2019-11-11, first said by David Schweikert in 2013. Twelve said "of agriculture usda." Twelve said "men and women who." What we held in common that month was the name of a grant program and a November holiday. We report this as we find it. The rest is in the count.
